title: AI-SDLC CapabilityMap
description: Binds pipeline stages (plan/implement/review/test) to PROVIDERS — an existing skill (e.g. code-plan, code-review-pr, code-security-scan) or a specialized agent (e.g. java-pro, security-auditor, qa-code-reviewer). This is how the framework's existing skills, agents, and agent-teams become first-class SDLC stages. Routing rules select the right provider per task (by language, labels, or Java-test-file detection); a review stage with >=3 providers is dispatched as a team (Native Teams). Cross-harness assignment (implementer harness != reviewer harness) is enforced at resolve time.

stages.description: Stage name -> binding. Recognized stages: plan, implement, review, test.

type.description: skill = an existing slash-command skill (code-plan, code-review-pr); agent = a specialized subagent.

role.description: Reviewer role label for review-stage providers (code-reviewer / test-reviewer / security-reviewer).

harness.description: Execution harness (e.g. claude, codex). For review providers this must differ from the implementer harness — enforced at resolve time.

routingRule.description: Conditional provider selection. First matching rule wins for single-provider stages; for team stages, matching rules add/replace providers.

languages.description: Match when the task touches any of these languages.

labels.description: Match when the task carries any of these labels.

javaTestFiles.description: Match when the task touches Java test files (routes to qa-code-reviewer).

provider.description: Replace the stage's provider(s) with this one when matched (single-provider stages).

addProvider.description: Add this provider to a team stage when matched.

replaceRole.description: For team stages: replace the provider with this role instead of appending.

provider.description: Default single provider for the stage.

providers.description: Provider set for a team stage (e.g. the 3 reviewers).

team.description: Force team dispatch. Otherwise team is inferred when >=3 providers resolve.

skill.description: Optional umbrella skill for the stage (e.g. code-review-pr) invoked instead of individual providers.
